EnableD20Variant.Name: Enable dice on d20 tests (ability + proficiency)
EnableD20Variant.Hint: When enabled, every d20 test (ability check, saving throw, skill, tool, attack) rolls an ability die and a proficiency die (when proficient) instead of flat bonuses, keeping the better of the two results.

EnableDamageVariant.Name: Enable dice on damage rolls
EnableDamageVariant.Hint: When enabled, the ability modifier added to damage becomes a die instead of a flat bonus, following the same table used for d20 tests.

EnableForwardInspiration.Name: Enable Forward Inspiration
EnableForwardInspiration.Hint: When enabled, whenever two of the dice rolled in a d20 test show the same value (including both d20s on advantage/disadvantage), the character gains Forward Inspiration: their next d20 roll automatically gets advantage.

Notifications.ProficiencyDisplayAligned: The dnd5e system's 'Proficiency Modifier' setting was switched to 'Dice' purely so character sheets display the proficiency bonus as a die (cosmetic only; the actual roll formula is computed by this module).
